name: William Wadé Harris
contribution: A Liberian Grebo evangelist, who preached in Liberia, Côte d'Ivoire and Ghana.

checks.lead: William Wadé Harris (c. 1860 – 1929) was a Liberian Grebo evangelist, who preached in Liberia, Côte d'Ivoire and Ghana. He has been described as the "most extraordinary one man evangelical crusade that Africa has ever known" and is considered one of the originators of today's prosperity gospel.
